items.name: Guild Shortsword
items.description: A plain, honest blade stamped with the Guild's lantern mark.

items.name: Tinker's Knife
items.description: Half knife, half screwdriver. Mostly knife when it matters.

items.name: Reed-Strung Bow
items.description: A fen bow of ash and waxed reed. Needs both hands.

items.name: Ferryman's Iron-Shod Pole
items.description: Three metres of oak with an iron cap. Two hands, long reach, heavy knock.

items.name: Watch Falchion
items.description: A broad, chopping blade issued to the Ford Watch.

items.name: Honed Tinker's Knife
items.description: The same knife, with an edge you could shave with.

items.name: Honed Guild Shortsword
items.description: The Guild blade, honed until the lantern mark gleams.

items.name: Honed Watch Falchion
items.description: A falchion with a fresh, bright edge.

items.name: Ferry-Plank Shield
items.description: Cut from an old ferry plank and banded with iron.

items.name: Padded Jack
items.description: Quilted wool, stiff with old sweat. Better than it looks.

items.name: Oilskin Coat
items.description: Keeps out rain, spray and the worst of a bite.

items.name: Tin Kettle Helm
items.description: Dented, unfashionable, and it has saved a lot of skulls.

items.name: Tarred Wading Boots
items.description: Waist-high and watertight. You hear the bog coming before it gets you.

items.name: Fog-Grey Cloak
items.description: Smuggler wool dyed the colour of sea mist.

items.name: Grippy Climbing Gloves
items.description: Pitch-dipped leather that sticks to wet rock.

items.name: Lantern Keeper's Greatcoat
items.description: Heavy, salt-stiff, lined with sheepskin. Turns a claw.

items.name: Wayfarer's Licence Ring
items.description: Brass ring stamped with the Guild lantern. Doors open a little wider for its wearer.

items.name: Wisp-Glass Ring
items.description: A ring set with a bead of wisp-glass that glows faintly near anything hidden.

items.name: Hive Sister's Amulet
items.description: A wax-sealed charm of the Hive Mother.

items.name: Willowmere Healing Tonic
items.description: Honey, yarrow and something the Sisters won't name. Knits cuts in minutes.

items.name: Honey Oat Cake
items.description: Dense, sticky and good for a day's walk.

items.name: Smoked Eel
items.description: Brindle's finest export, apparently.

items.name: Bog Hare Haunch
items.description: Lean, gamey and better roasted.

items.name: Bottle of Bog-Myrtle Mead
items.description: Golden, bitter-sweet. The Hive Mother likes it poured on her stones.

items.name: Yarrow-Steeped Tonic
items.description: A Willowmere tonic steeped with fresh yarrow. Twice the kick.

items.name: Smelling Salts
items.description: One sniff and you're wide awake, and slightly offended.

items.name: Guild Lockpick Roll
items.description: Six picks and a tension bar in a leather roll.

items.name: River Whetstone
items.description: A grey river stone worn smooth on one face. Drop it on a blade in your bag to hone it; it never wears out.

items.name: Tinker's Toolkit
items.description: Files, tongs, a tiny anvil and a lot of wire. Needed for tinkering.

items.name: Herbalist's Satchel
items.description: Mortar, pestle, vials and labelled pouches. Needed for remedies.

items.name: Leatherworker's Roll
items.description: Awls, waxed thread and a skiving knife. Needed for leatherwork.

items.name: Coil of Climbing Rope
items.description: Fifteen metres of good hemp.

items.name: Guild Whistle
items.description: A brass whistle that can be heard across the whole ford.

items.name: Examiner's Practice Key
items.description: Opens the Guild's practice lockbox. Using it is technically allowed.

items.name: Gull Rock Lighthouse Key
items.description: A green-crusted bronze key as long as your hand.

items.name: The Trial Ledger
items.description: Your Guild trials, ten lines long. Odile signs each one when you are done.

items.name: Crate of Hive Honey
items.description: Sealed crock-jars bound for the Quill & Candle. Heavier than it looks.

items.name: The Everflame Wick
items.description: A braided wick that has burned for a hundred years. It went out the night the Keeper drowned.

items.name: The Keeper's Logbook
items.description: Last entry: 'The bell rings on its own now. I will go down and see.'

items.name: Saltreed Token
items.description: A carved fish on a cord. Show it in the cove and nobody draws steel.

items.name: Bristle Bear Claw
items.description: Longer than your finger and black as tar.

items.name: Fogback Venom Gland
items.description: Handle with gloves. Alchemists pay well for it.

items.name: Thornback Gryphon Feather
items.description: Copper-barred and as long as your arm.

items.name: Bottle of Smuggled Brandy
items.description: No tax stamp. Tamsin buys these and asks nothing.

items.name: Saltreed Pearl
items.description: Slightly lumpy, definitely valuable.

items.name: Tide Warden's Censer
items.description: Silver, tarnished green, still smelling of incense.
